query:
WITH latest_snapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS max_snap
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
household_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.region,
        hp.person_type,
        hp.id AS member_id,
        d.head_of_household_id
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
    JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON hp.id = d.id
    CROSS JOIN latest_snapshot ls
    WHERE hp.snapshot = ls.max_snap
      AND hp.is_in_population = TRUE
      AND hl.region IS NOT NULL
),
family_sizes AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        person_type,
        head_of_household_id,
        COUNT(member_id) AS family_size
    FROM household_counts
    WHERE head_of_household_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY region, person_type, head_of_household_id
)
SELECT 
    region,
    person_type,
    ROUND(AVG(family_size), 2) AS avg_family_size
FROM family_sizes
GROUP BY region, person_type
ORDER BY region, person_type LIMIT 1200
